verdict.line: You win if you punish Sion's Q cooldown windows and shred his shield with empowered W before it pops; you lose if you trade passively and let his max-health stacking and level 6 Cannibalism carry the fight.

brief.thesis: Sion's whole early kit runs through two long-cooldown commitments — Q (Cryptic Gaze, 12-8s cooldown) and W (Death's Caress) — and Renekton's W (Ruthless Predator) directly answers both, stunning him out of the Q cast and, once empowered past 50 Fury, outright destroying the W shield before it detonates. That's why Renekton holds the lane and solo-kill edge here even though the raw head-to-head sits at 48.1% over 104 games — the tools favor you, the macro numbers are just close.

theirWindow.when: Sion lands Q stun on you
theirWindow.what: He gets a free auto-reset window and can toggle E to trade AD for health on top of it. Back off a step the instant the stun breaks rather than standing in follow-up autos.

yourWindow.when: Sion's Q is on cooldown or mid-charge
yourWindow.what: Walk him down and W him — at 0.75s base stun you lock him for a full extra auto, and if you're above 50 Fury the triple-slash version destroys his W shield outright and stuns for 1.5s. Follow with Q (Cull the Meek) since it hits everyone around you and heals you back.

W stun lengthens, punish every Q whiff

start.why: 83.7% pick rate and the healing-per-hit from Reign of Anger stacks with the extra sustain to win early trade wars against Sion's Q poke.

boots.why: 57.7% pick rate; Sion's entire kit (Q stun into autos, E auto-trading) is basic-attack damage, which Steelcaps directly cuts down.

core.why: The shield-on-burst and empowered-auto proc punishes Sion the moment his Death's Caress shield is down, matching the 45.5% WR Eclipse-first path.
Armor shred stacks on top of your empowered E's own armor reduction, letting your W stun-chain actually kill instead of just poking.
Bleeds through Sion's damage so his Q/E trades can't burst you down while you're mid-combo.

situational.when: sion is landing clean q stuns and burst-killing you before your combo finishes
sion has stacked significant bonus max health from his e passive and is out-scaling flat damage
you want faster cooldown resets to chain empowered w more often in extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: 46.7% WR at 45.1% pick — the sustained-fight healing matches Renekton's extended trade pattern into Sion's own E self-damage sustain.

summoners.why: 48.3% WR at 66.9% pick — Ignite punishes Sion's habit of healing back chip damage and secures solo kills during your W-stun windows, where Renekton already holds the edge. Flash+Teleport (47.6%, 31.6% pick) is the alternative if you need to reset for sidelane pressure instead.

playing.title: Walk up during his Q charge
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze has a visible cast before it fires — close to W range (300) while he's charging and stun him out of it. Missing Q costs him 8-12 seconds of cooldown, which is your entire trading window.

playing.title: Save empowered W for his shield
playing.detail: Once above 50 Fury, W's triple-slash destroys damage shields outright. Hold the stun for the moment he throws up Death's Caress instead of using it on a raw engage.

playing.title: Track your own Fury bar constantly
playing.detail: Both your Q and W double in value above 50 Fury. Auto him and land Q hits before committing to a stun combo so the upgrade is live when you need it.

playing.title: Disengage the instant his stun breaks
playing.detail: Sion's follow-up after Q is all basic attacks, which Steelcaps and spacing neutralize. Don't stand and trade autos back — reset with your own attacks and back off.

playing.title: Respect level 6 but don't fear it
playing.detail: Cannibalism gives him lifesteal and attack speed in a fight, but your own R burst still wins short trades. Avoid dragging fights long once he's popped R; end it fast or walk away.

playing.title: Use E to close, not just to poke
playing.detail: Slice and Dice's 450 range lets you dash in before his Q lands rather than after. Engage on your terms during his charge-up, not his.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Gain the upper hand in combat by cancelling Sion’s (Q) with [W] while it is charging. Always keep Sion using (Q) inside brushes in mind.
